It directly measures sunscreen effectiveness on human skin, ensuring accurate and reliable results. How to Use Ultra Light Sunscreen SPF50+ ? Step 1 On cleansed and toned skin, apply a generous amount of sunscreen on the face and neck. Important Information To see a noticeable difference in your skin, it is recommended that you use this Ultra Light SPF 50+ Sunscreen regularly and consistently for 3-4 months. Patch tests are easy to ensure you don't experience any initial adverse reaction when using a new product. We recommend doing a patch test before starting any new product on your skin. You can conduct a patch test by following the below steps: 1. Apply the product to a small patch of skin either to the arm or bend of the elbow 2. Keep the area dry 3. Leave on for 12-24 hours (or less if the product isn’t a leave-on product) 4. If any redness, itching, or irritation is observed at any time during the test, do not use the product,; you can safely use it Suitable for • All skin types Helps • Protect skin from UVA and UVB rays • Deeply hydrates skin • Improve skin tone • Targets and heals acne • Leaves skin feeling smooth Ratings & Reviews 4.6 214 Reviews 5 145 4 60 3 9 2 1 Lightweight V lightweight on skin, does not leave white cast! Answers that we believe must be heard. Frequently asked questions About Ultra Light Sunscreen SPF50+ Is this suitable for all skin types? It is suitable for all skin types. AcZero technology present makes it completely safe even for active acne or acne-prone skin. But since every skin type is different, we recommend doing a patch test before incorporating it in your routine. Will it leave a white cast? Be Bodywise Ultra Light Sunscreen has a lightweight aqua gel like texture and doesn't leave a white cast Does it have fragrance? No, this sunscreen has no added fragrance. Is it sweat/water resistant? Yes, it is clinically proven to have water & sweat resistance, upto 80 mins. Is it oily? No, the formulation is aquagel based. Thus, it does not feel oily or sticky on face. Is it sticky? No, it is not sticky.
